evidence_summary: Vertical slice verified: real/cached OpenCaseLaw input produces source-linked result bundle (cited ids subset of bundle, counter-authority candidates present) and clickable map (8 clusters, 105 decisions/query, test_query_map_mvp green). 11/11 MVP tests pass. Write scope clean (product/, results/product/, reports/product/, state/product.json only). Zero external cost: opencode/*-free models, public OpenCaseLaw endpoints, no API keys. All cited canonical_urls on https://mcp.opencaselaw.ch/. Fixture/live paths strictly separated in query/corpus.py.

vertical_slice_verification.real_cached_opencase_law_input: PASS — fixture mode uses frozen OpenCaseLaw envelopes; live mode hits mcp.opencaselaw.ch/api with strict fixture/live separation
vertical_slice_verification.source_linked_result_bundle: PASS — cited decision ids ⊆ bundle ids; per-decision citation + counter_status present (5-12 counter candidates per query); structural gate cited_ids ⊆ bundle_ids verified
vertical_slice_verification.clickable_map: PASS — 8 clusters, 105 decisions per query, coordinates finite and bounded [-1,1], deterministic (ga==gb across runs), outlier detection active, test_query_map_mvp.py 11/11 green
vertical_slice_verification.sourced_generative_answer: PASS — generative_audit_llm_v2 with independent_llm_adversarial_v2 (space-bunny-free); error=null on all legs; answer cites only retrieved decision IDs
vertical_slice_verification.zero_external_cost: PASS — opencode/*-free models, public OpenCaseLaw endpoints, no API keys under product/, all canonical_urls on mcp.opencaselaw.ch
vertical_slice_verification.fixture_live_separation: PASS — query/corpus.py enforces strict separation; live never padded with fixture rows; content-addressed product cache (results/product/query_cache, 189 entries) holds previously live-fetched envelopes

known_limitations: Fixture mode uses placeholder generative answer; real model needed for content quality verification
Real model generation requires free model availability (nemotron-3-ultra-free)
Legacy 174k server/tests require sentence-transformers and corpus artifacts (not on MVP critical path)
Latency budgets from QUERY_MAP_MVP §9A not yet measured on live retrieval path
